name: @0k/vue-split-tabs
description: Content-agnostic Vue 3 split tabs with persistent layout intent and keep-mounted content.
author: Valentin Lab <valentin.lab@kalysto.org>

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs clean && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build --configLoader runner && node scripts/build.mjs css
scripts.demo: npm run build && vite --configLoader runner --config demo/vite.config.ts --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.demo:build: npm run build && vue-tsc --noEmit -p demo/tsconfig.json && vite build --configLoader runner --config demo/vite.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && node test/build.mjs && node test/types.mjs && npm run test:browser && npm run demo:test
